literal_meaning: উড়ো খই (উড়ন্ত খই) গোবিন্দায় (কৃষ্ণের নাম) নমঃ (নমস্কার বা উৎসর্গ)
figurative_meaning_en: To give away something one does not possess
similar_in_english: To offer pie in the sky
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা শুনে বুঝলাম, সে উড়ো খই গোবিন্দায় নমঃ করছে।
এই প্রকল্পে তার প্রতিশ্রুতি মাত্র উড়ো খই গোবিন্দায় নমঃ।
example_sentences_in_english: From his words, I realized he was just offering flying puffed rice to Govinda.
His promise on this project is nothing but offering flying puffed rice to Govinda.
history: This idiom draws from Bengali folk traditions where 'উড়ো খই' symbolizes something light and worthless that flies away easily, offered in a chant to Govinda (Krishna), implying insincere or impossible donations.
note: The idiom highlights the cultural blend of everyday sarcasm with Vaishnava devotional elements in Bengal.
